chose: /essay?week=<id> draws only that week's essay. When it can't be read, or what is read belongs to another week, the stage says why and draws nothing, even outside a recording. The sample plays only with no week named, or week=sample.
options: refuse, saying why, whenever a named essay can't be read
fall back to the sample outside a recording, as /call does with a week
gray: /call shows its sample week when a live week can't be read, unless it is recording. An essay carries the owner's own words and takes, though, and a sample drawn in its place reads as theirs. No rule decides it.
undo: Have essayStageOf return the sample with voicing "sample" when it isn't recording, as stageOf in view.ts does.
